newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Tecnimont wins Egypt sugar refinery deal.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Tecnimont wins Egypt sugar refinery deal.

text.p: Tecnimont SpA, the plant engineering unit of Italy's Montedison group, has won a contract from Egypt's Misr Co for Sugar Production to build a sugar refinery at Nobaria in the Nile Delta.
Tecnimont is a sister company of the agro-industrial multinational and sugar producer Eridania Beghin-Say (EBS).

The plant, which will involve global investment of around $130 million, will be able to handle 7,000 tonnes of beet per day with average annual production of 150,000 tonnes of sugar. It will also be able to refine 100,000 tonnes per year of imported raw sugar.
A Montedison statement said the refinery is due to start production in 1999. Tecnimont will not only build the plant but will also have a management contract with EBS support.
